comment: Where the desktop app gets its game payload.
The HTML is downloaded at build time and never committed (it is >100 MB).
1. GAME_LOCAL  env  - path to an HTML file already on disk
2. GAME_URL    env  - direct download URL (CI reads the GAME_URL repo variable)
Pinned to an exact release tag so builds are reproducible. The moving
- if you use that, clear sha256 below, because it changes every release.
name: Gaius 26.3 (TeaVM-compiled Minecraft Java client)

alternatives.goldhq: no fixed URL - client.goldhq.net assembles its offline HTML in the browser; host the file yourself and set the GAME_URL repo variable
